build_deepvit_model: build a DeepViT vision transformer model for image classification with configurable patch size and depth
create_attention_module: create a multi-head self-attention module with re-attention mechanism for transformer blocks
create_transformer_encoder: create a transformer encoder stack with alternating attention and feed-forward layers
create_feedforward_network: create a feedforward network with layer normalization, GELU activation, and dropout
test_deepvit_forward: test the DeepViT forward pass on a batch of images and verify classification output shape
